question: What is the prescribed range for this branch measurement?
premises: The measurement begins at seven finger-units.
The upper limit is the number of finger-units equal to the syllables of the gāyatrī.
inference: The measurement ranges from seven finger-units up to twenty-four finger-units.
plain_english: Beginning with seven finger-units, up to the number of finger-units equal to the syllables of the gāyatrī.
